hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Discover the story behind Daffa for Abayat - where tradition meets contemporary elegance

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: At Daffa for Abayat, we are passionate about providing modest fashion that celebrates elegance, tradition, and modern style. Our mission is to empower women with beautiful, high-quality abayas that make them feel confident and graceful in every moment.
mission.subtitle: We believe that modesty and fashion can coexist beautifully, and we're committed to bringing you the finest collection of abayas that reflect your unique style and values.

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.description: We source the finest fabrics and materials to ensure every abaya meets our high standards of excellence.

craftsmanship.title: Expert Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.description: Each piece is carefully crafted by skilled artisans who pay attention to every detail.

authenticity.title: Authentic Design
authenticity.description: Our designs honor traditional modesty while embracing contemporary fashion trends.

service.title: Customer First
service.description: Your satisfaction is our priority. We're dedicated to providing exceptional service and support.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Founded with a vision to redefine modest fashion, Daffa for Abayat has grown from a small boutique to a trusted name in elegant abaya wear. We understand that every woman deserves to feel beautiful and confident, and our collection is designed to celebrate diversity, elegance, and individuality.
